# Microsoft Learn

> > Microsoft's official learning platform providing technical documentation, training paths, certifications, and product lifecycle information across Azure, Windows, Microsoft Defender, and the broader Microsoft ecosystem.

Microsoft Learn serves as the comprehensive knowledge hub for IT professionals, developers, and learners seeking to build skills in Microsoft technologies. The platform combines hands-on training modules, certification preparation, product documentation, and lifecycle policies for Windows, Azure, security products, and AI tools like Microsoft Copilot.

## Key Topics

- Azure cloud computing
- Windows 11 and Windows 10
- Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
- Microsoft Certification programs
- Modern Lifecycle Policy
- Windows as a Service (WaaS)
- Microsoft Copilot and AI
- Windows Security
- Microsoft Azure Fundamentals
- Technical training and developer education
- Threat remediation and antivirus protection
- Product lifecycle and support dates
- Cloud computing resources

## Learning Platform & Training

- [Microsoft Learn: Build skills that open doors in your career](https://learn.microsoft.com/): Homepage for Microsoft Learn training, certifications, and documentation

## Windows Lifecycle & Support

- [Windows 11 Home and Pro - Microsoft Lifecycle](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-11-home-and-pro): Windows 11 Home and Pro lifecycle policy and support dates
- [Windows 10 Home and Pro - Microsoft Lifecycle](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/lifecycle/products/windows-10-home-and-pro): Windows 10 Home and Pro lifecycle policy and support dates

## Security & Threat Protection

- [Restore quarantined files in Microsoft Defender Antivirus](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/defender-endpoint/restore-quarantined-files-microsoft-defender-antivirus): Guide to restore quarantined files in Microsoft Defender Antivirus
